concerns.text: Task ID **T024** is used twice – once as an implementation task in US2 (re‑run t‑tests on cleaned data) and again as a unit‑test task in US3. Duplicate IDs break deterministic ordering and make dependency resolution ambiguous.

Task **T044** is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but modifies `code/utils.py`, a file also written by earlier foundational tasks (T004‑T007). Parallel execution could cause race conditions; the `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.

User Story 3 (US3) tasks depend on artifacts produced by US1 and US2 (e.g., `baseline_metrics.json`, `cleaned_metrics.json`). This violates the rule that each US block must be an independently‑shippable unit; US3 cannot be tested in isolation.
